## Chemical interpretation

All inputs are simulated teaching data. The supplied endpoint of 25.00 mL of 0.1000 mol/L base for 25.00 mL acid gives 0.1000 mol/L acid. A slope maximum is an exploratory endpoint check, not complete endpoint validation. The weak acid has the same equivalence amount but a different pH curve.

## Transfer and limits

Hardness results are 123.1107, 124.1116 and 191.1719 mg/L as CaCO3. The transfer is 160.144 mg/L as CaCO3. State blank subtraction and the conditional selective 1:1 Ca/Mg–EDTA model. Do not infer carbonate presence or separate calcium and magnesium concentrations.

The complete executable solution is in `R/analyse-titration.R`. The student lesson
and data dictionary specify the measurand, input units and row meanings. A
conditional teaching result is not full method validation.
